prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a dark, high-contrast poster with a moody underground-club aesthetic. The composition features a chest-up, slightly low-angle monochrome portrait of an adult woman wearing large over-ear headphones and reflective round sunglasses with warm amber-gold lenses. One hand is raised near her hairline and the other rests near her chin in a dynamic, expressive music-immersion pose. Place a large flat mustard-yellow circular shape behind her head as a graphic spotlight. Use a deep black background with subtle grunge textures, dust, scratches, and printed-flyer wear. Keep the portrait mostly black and white with amber-gold selective color in the lenses. Use a 4:5 aspect ratio and do not render text, logos, or watermarks.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, text, logo, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed, distorted headphones, unreadable typography
